content: To address the first challenge, we develop a sentence classifier to judge whether a sentence contains radiological findings. To minimize manual-labeling overhead, we propose easy ways of constructing positive and negative training examples, develop a bootstrapping approach to mine hard examples, and use hard examples to re-train the classifier for reducing false positives. To address the second challenge, we use constituent parsing to recognize noun phrases which contain critical medical information (e.g., lesions, abnormalities, diseases) and are easy to index and digest. We select noun phrases with top frequencies for medical professionals to further investigate.
